content: As for the failed samples, the most common reason comes from the anonymity issue, which is also shown in Fig. FIGREF47 . As mentioned above, we conduct name replacement. However, some critical elements are also anonymized by the government, due to the privacy issue. These elements are sometimes important to judgment prediction. For example, determination of the key factor long-time separation is relevant to the explicit dates, which are anonymized.
